verdict.rationale: Rippling documents integrations with accounting systems (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite) and offers developer APIs/sandbox and a CLI for building custom integrations, which could support pulling payroll data programmatically, but there is no explicit mention of a payroll journal export/API or agent-driven reconciliation workflow into a ledger. missing for 10: explicit payroll journal API/export documentation, agent-specific reconciliation tooling, and any hands-on evidence of this exact workflow.
